risks.risk: Whether it actually works (heat/airflow) and whether the motor runs properly under load.

risks.risk: Electrical safety condition (cord/plug, switch, and any intermittent faults).
risks.proof: Clear photo of the plug and cable condition plus a video showing stable operation without sparking/odors.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially needing electrical checks.

risks.risk: Missing/incorrect accessories or attachments (e.g., nozzle/parts) affecting usability.
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out (nozzle, attachments, stand parts, manual if any).

risks.risk: Exact model and power rating unknown, which affects value and comparables.
risks.proof: Photo of the rating plate/spec label (voltage/wattage/model number) on the unit.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at a generic hair dryer unit level for the brand without model premium.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the rating plate/spec label (model number, voltage, wattage).
Send a short video of it running (airflow + heat) for 30–60 seconds.
Send clear photos of the plug and cable, and show the switch/controls working.
Show the receipt and warranty card (photos of both documents).
Show all included parts/accessories laid out.
response.reason: The photos identify it as an Equator hair dryer unit, but there’s no working test, no visible model/power rating, and the key claims (no fault, motor never opened, receipt/warranty) are not verifiable from the images. Proof is needed to price confidently.
